title: Crimson Gothic Overlord
description: A mysterious figure wearing an ornate white mask with red cracks and glowing green windows stands centered in a dark gothic city. The figure's robe is deep red and black with architectural window motifs, moss, and braided hair adorned with small glowing structures, set against a blood-red sky with dramatic red light beams.
prompt: A haunting figure centered in frame wearing an intricate white porcelain mask with red vein-like cracks and glowing green stained-glass windows for eyes, elaborate dark red and black robes designed with gothic cathedral window patterns, overgrown with moss and ivy, braided hair with miniature glowing structures, standing before a sprawling dark gothic cityscape with towering spires under a blood-red stormy sky with dramatic crimson light rays cutting through the clouds, dark fantasy atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
